title: 2-Bus Wind & Gas Economic Dispatch
description: Minimal 380 kV two-bus PyPSA energy system dispatching zero-marginal-cost northern wind generation alongside southern combined-cycle gas generation across an AC corridor.
code:
network WindGas_2Bus baseMva=100
bus North v_nom=380 carrier=AC
bus South v_nom=380 carrier=AC
generator Wind_North bus=North carrier=wind p_nom=500 marginal_cost=0 capital_cost=1200
generator CCGT_South bus=South carrier=gas p_nom=450 marginal_cost=52 capital_cost=650
load Load_South bus=South p_set=620
line Line_NS bus0=North bus1=South r=2.1 x=21.5 s_nom=700

title: 3-Bus Meshed Grid with Transmission Congestion & LMPs
description: Three-bus 230 kV triangular meshed network demonstrating Kirchhoff loop flows, binding thermal line limits, and locational marginal price (LMP) separation.
code:
network Mesh3_Congestion baseMva=100
bus BusA v_nom=230 carrier=AC
bus BusB v_nom=230 carrier=AC
bus BusC v_nom=230 carrier=AC
generator Hydro_A bus=BusA carrier=hydro p_nom=400 marginal_cost=12 capital_cost=1800
generator Gas_B bus=BusB carrier=gas p_nom=350 marginal_cost=58 capital_cost=600
generator Peaker_C bus=BusC carrier=oil p_nom=250 marginal_cost=115 capital_cost=400
load Demand_B bus=BusB p_set=180
load Demand_C bus=BusC p_set=420
line Line_AB bus0=BusA bus1=BusB r=1.2 x=12.0 s_nom=300
line Line_BC bus0=BusB bus1=BusC r=1.5 x=15.0 s_nom=220
line Line_AC bus0=BusA bus1=BusC r=2.0 x=18.0 s_nom=200

title: 24-Hour Solar PV & Battery Storage LOPF Arbitrage
description: Multi-file PyPSA linear optimal power flow model pairing utility-scale solar PV, 4-hour lithium-ion BESS storage, and backup gas generation with a 24-hour capacity-factor and demand profile CSV.
code:
network SolarBESS_24h baseMva=100
bus SolarHub v_nom=230 carrier=AC
bus CityLoad v_nom=230 carrier=AC
generator PV_Farm bus=SolarHub carrier=solar p_nom=600 marginal_cost=0 capital_cost=850
generator Gas_Backup bus=CityLoad carrier=gas p_nom=500 marginal_cost=64 capital_cost=600
load Metro_Demand bus=CityLoad p_set=480
line Corridor_SC bus0=SolarHub bus1=CityLoad r=1.8 x=16.5 s_nom=550
storage_unit BESS_Hub bus=SolarHub p_nom=150 max_hours=4 efficiency_store=0.93 efficiency_dispatch=0.93 standing_loss=0.001
storage_unit BESS_City bus=CityLoad p_nom=100 max_hours=4 efficiency_store=0.92 efficiency_dispatch=0.92 standing_loss=0.001

title: Sector-Coupled Power-to-Heat & Green Hydrogen Network
description: Multi-carrier PyPSA energy network coupling electricity, district heating (heat pumps + thermal storage), and green hydrogen electrolysis via directional conversion links and companion demand CSV.
code:
network SectorCoupled_P2X baseMva=100
bus Elec_Grid v_nom=380 carrier=AC
bus District_Heat v_nom=1 carrier=heat
bus H2_Bus v_nom=1 carrier=H2
generator Offshore_Wind bus=Elec_Grid carrier=wind p_nom=900 marginal_cost=0 capital_cost=1650
generator Solar_PV bus=Elec_Grid carrier=solar p_nom=500 marginal_cost=0 capital_cost=800
generator Backup_CCGT bus=Elec_Grid carrier=gas p_nom=400 marginal_cost=68 capital_cost=620
load Elec_Demand bus=Elec_Grid p_set=520
load Heat_Demand bus=District_Heat p_set=260
load H2_Industry bus=H2_Bus p_set=140
link HeatPump_P2H bus0=Elec_Grid bus1=District_Heat p_nom=350 efficiency=0.95
link PEM_Electrolyzer bus0=Elec_Grid bus1=H2_Bus p_nom=250 efficiency=0.68
link H2_FuelCell bus0=H2_Bus bus1=Elec_Grid p_nom=120 efficiency=0.58
storage_unit Thermal_Tank bus=District_Heat p_nom=120 max_hours=12 efficiency_store=0.96 efficiency_dispatch=0.96 standing_loss=0.005
storage_unit H2_Cavern bus=H2_Bus p_nom=150 max_hours=48 efficiency_store=0.98 efficiency_dispatch=0.98 standing_loss=0.0001

title: Multi-Region European Renewable Capacity Expansion
description: Multi-file four-region 380 kV AC + HVDC subsea interconnector PyPSA capacity expansion network paired with regional wind/solar capacity factors (wind_solar_cf.csv) and hourly regional loads (loads.csv).
code:
network EU_4Region_Expansion baseMva=100
bus DE_North v_nom=380 carrier=AC
bus DE_South v_nom=380 carrier=AC
bus FR_West v_nom=380 carrier=AC
bus NO_Hydro v_nom=380 carrier=AC
generator Wind_DE_N bus=DE_North carrier=wind p_nom=1800 marginal_cost=0 capital_cost=1350
generator Solar_DE_S bus=DE_South carrier=solar p_nom=1400 marginal_cost=0 capital_cost=780
generator Nuclear_FR bus=FR_West carrier=nuclear p_nom=1600 marginal_cost=14 capital_cost=4200
generator Hydro_NO bus=NO_Hydro carrier=hydro p_nom=1500 marginal_cost=5 capital_cost=2100
generator CCGT_DE_S bus=DE_South carrier=gas p_nom=900 marginal_cost=62 capital_cost=640
load Load_DE_N bus=DE_North p_set=1100
load Load_DE_S bus=DE_South p_set=1450
load Load_FR bus=FR_West p_set=1200
load Load_NO bus=NO_Hydro p_set=650
line AC_DE_NS bus0=DE_North bus1=DE_South r=1.6 x=18.0 s_nom=1600
line AC_DE_FR bus0=DE_South bus1=FR_West r=2.0 x=22.0 s_nom=1400
link HVDC_NordLink bus0=NO_Hydro bus1=DE_North p_nom=1400 efficiency=0.96
link HVDC_SuedLink bus0=DE_North bus1=DE_South p_nom=2000 efficiency=0.97
storage_unit BESS_DE_S bus=DE_South p_nom=400 max_hours=4 efficiency_store=0.92 efficiency_dispatch=0.92 standing_loss=0.001
storage_unit PSH_NO bus=NO_Hydro p_nom=600 max_hours=24 efficiency_store=0.86 efficiency_dispatch=0.86 standing_loss=0.0002
